method: Paginated GitHub REST inventory; token/path/email shape review of returned bodies, comments and available Actions logs. No payloads retained. Automated text scan is not exhaustive semantic or visual review.
scope_limitations: Pagination is a time-window snapshot, not an atomic repository freeze; later records including these PRs require release-time recheck.

Reviewed current REST bodies/comments, review summaries, advertised Actions logs, and available artifacts. Edit history, deleted records, hidden PR refs, commit metadata, check annotations/summaries beyond logs, and content at external links are not exhaustively reviewed.
Attachment detection covers GitHub user-attachments and user-images links in returned bodies; absence of matches is not proof that all externally linked files were discovered.
No releases or release assets were returned; no attachment links matched the detector.
zero_count_limit: No actual credential was established in reviewed content. This does not certify unreviewed or undiscovered surfaces.
api_method: gh api --paginate --slurp with per_page=100 for issues?state=all, issues/comments, pulls/comments, pulls?state=all and each pulls/N/reviews, releases, actions/runs, actions/artifacts; gh api actions/runs/ID/logs and actions/artifacts/ID/zip. All relative to repos/elanthus/OSWorldTasks. Exit 0 for inventories and downloads in this snapshot.
path_finding_resource_format: Integer means Actions run ID; string means exact discussion or artifact resource URL. Each pair records resource and occurrence count. Every row is an operator-path shape, not a credential finding.
